trial_court: Court of Dig Vinay Singh, District Judge (Commercial Court)-03, West, Tis Hazari Courts Extension Block, Delhi
case_name: Lgp Infrastructure Llp vs Yfc Project Pvt. Ltd

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: LGP Infrastructure LLP, Through its Directors Sh. Sushant Ghosh and S/o Sh. Nimai Ghosh
parties.respondent_defendant: YFC Project Pvt. Ltd., Through its AR/ Director Shop no.13, C-72, Ground Floor, Khasra no.583, North Avenue Road, Shankar Market, Shivaji Park, West Punjabi Bagh, Delhi-110026.

facts_of_case: The plaintiff provided 'Labour Hutments and Cast' at the site of the defendant qua Delhi Metro Rail Project. The plaintiff raised 4 invoices between 09.07.2020 to 05.07.2021 upon the defendant for a total sum of ₹26,41,075/-.

legal_principles.principle: A party's claim must be supported by evidence and not just rely on suspicion.
legal_principles.held: No other documentary proof is proven to show that the plaintiff performed the work under the work order in question. A perusal of the 4 invoices and the running bills forming part of Ext. PW1/4 creates suspicion about the claim of the plaintiff for the following reasons.

legal_principles.principle: A party must plead and prove their case with specificity, rather than relying on inference or suspicion.
legal_principles.held: If it is the case of the plaintiff that the plaintiff performed work for the defendant even before the work order in question, there should have been a specific pleading to that effect. But neither there is pleading to that effect, nor there is any deposition.

outcome.final_order: The court ordered the recovery of ₹18,65,370/- along with pendent lite and future interest @ 24% per annum.

use_for_drafting: drafting a commercial suit for recovery of amount
preparing a non-starter report for mediation
using the Commercial Courts Act, 2015 in a construction contract dispute
